description: Average residential electricity price (cents per kWh), monthly use, monthly bill, and 1- and 5-year price change for a U.S. state, D.C., or the U.S. overall, over the latest 12 months of EIA data. Omit `state` to get all 50 states and D.C., sorted by price.

state.description: Two-letter code, state name, or 'US'. Omit for every state.

name: get_state_electricity_stats
title: Average electricity rate and bill by state
